decision: Location is a content child of KitSection, not a LocationSection wrapper
why: The brief forbids a second model. Text is the same shape: one content recordable under the kit section.
Location does not list host parents. The capability is how a place becomes a legal child.
Location has no declared allowed_parent_types. Declared-only would hide it from + Section.
Location owns fields, validation, and formatting. Press Kits only wraps them as a section.

decision: Nest location on the kit section payload, matching videos
why: Agents need structured place fields on the complete kit walk. No second Location API.

decision: Optional OpenStreetMap link, no embed and no geocode on save
why: The brief asked for a simple external link and forbade auto geocoding.
